chunks: So We delivered him and those with him in the loaded ark,

key_terms.فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ: So We delivered him (referring to Prophet Nuh)

ai.seo_question: How did Prophet Noah and his followers survive the Great Flood according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of divine preservation (Hifz) for the faithful amidst cosmic trials, linking the 'loaded ark' to the Ahl al-Bayt as the vessel of salvation. It serves as a typological precursor to the survival of the righteous through the Great Flood, illustrating that true deliverance is contingent upon adherence to the chosen leader, much like Nuh's family was saved while others perished.
